name: popsicle
headline: Catafract: AI marketing and content platform
short_description: The marketing development platform built for AI agents. Catafract is the all-in-one platform to create content, do marketing and distribute your apps.
author: doasfrancisco

sections.overview:
Catafract is a marketing development platform built specifically for AI agents working with tools like Claude Code and Cursor. It provides an integrated workspace for creating content, managing marketing campaigns, and distributing applications. The platform features a canvas-based interface with node management for organizing marketing workflows and content projects. Catafract enables AI agents to streamline their marketing operations by consolidating content creation, distribution, and project management into a single tool.
Creating and organizing marketing content with visual node-based workflows
Managing and distributing AI agent applications across channels
Coordinating multi-step marketing campaigns in a unified interface
Building content projects with structured, reusable components
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/doasfrancisco/catafract`
sections.usage:
```
Act as a marketing expert using Catafract. Create a 30-day social media content calendar for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] space. Include post ideas, optimal posting times, and engagement strategies. Focus on driving brand awareness and lead generation.
```
Copy

```
# 30-Day Social Media Content Calendar for [COMPANY] in [INDUSTRY]
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
